glosses: A mesh of string, cord or rope.

examples.text: a hairnet; a mosquito net; a tennis net

examples.text: Then there came a reg'lar terror of a sou'wester same as you don't get one summer in a thousand, and blowed the shanty flat and ripped about half of the weir poles out of the sand. glosses: A device made from such mesh, generally used for trapping something.

examples.text: The nets have to be checked to make sure that they are not tangled up and therefore useless, and the carcasses of the dead sharks are removed.

glosses: Anything that has the appearance of such a device.

examples.text: Petri net

glosses: A trap.

A system that interconnects a number of users, locations etc. allowing transport or communication between them.

examples.text: Wigan had N'Zogbia sent off late on but Squillaci headed into his own net to give the home side a deserved point.

examples.text: Evans netted the winner in the 80th minute.
Romeu then scored a penalty, Torres netted a header and Moses added the sixth from substitute Oscar's cross.

examples.text: Azarenka whipped a sensational forehand around the net post to break for 2-0 in the second set, followed it up with a love hold and moved to 5-1 when Paszek netted a forehand.

examples.text: I was shown into a pretty but rather close drawing-room, and there sat Agnes, netting a purse.

glosses: Good, desirable; clean, decent, clear.

examples.text: Her brest all naked, as net iuory, / Without adorne of gold or siluer bright […]

glosses: Free from extraneous substances; pure; unadulterated; neat.

glosses: Remaining after expenses or deductions.

examples.text: net profit; net weight

glosses: Final; end.

examples.text: net result; net conclusion

examples.text: You'll have $5000 net.

examples.text: Our net on that transaction was only fourteen dollars.

glosses: To receive as profit.

examples.text: The company nets $30 on every sale.

glosses: To yield as profit for.

examples.text: The scam netted the criminals $30,000.

glosses: To fully hedge a position.

examples.text: Every party is netting their position with a counter-party.

glosses: To clean, wash, rinse.

examples.text: Nous sommes désormais dans un monde où les réseaux peu structurés d'individus, et plus seulement les organisations formelles, deviennent de puissants créateurs de connaissance et d'action.

rets, filet, tissu de mailles.

examples.text: Tendre un réseau.

Que ne puis-je, comme l'oiseau
Voler vers ton rivage ?

L'a mis en esclavage.

glosses: Il se dit spécialement d’un ouvrage de fil, de soie, de fil d’or ou d’argent, fait par petites mailles, en forme de filet.

examples.text: Réseau artériel, veineux, de nerfs.
